channel.title: Alexandre Cormeraie — Cormeraie
channel.description: One goal: build the best possible experience — with AI. My apps, my essays, what I admire.

item.title: Get ready for the new platform
item.description: Android and iOS are platforms, not two targets of the same codebase. With AI, two new platforms are arriving — MCP on one side, App Intents on the other — and they are not worked the same way.

item.title: Vibe coding was only the beginning
item.description: It was never made for the enterprise. What comes next is non-technical people creating software without seeing a single line of code — and that takes an organisation nobody is tooling for yet.
